## Short bio

::: bio
Dominic Bräm is a postdoctoral researcher in Pediatric Clinical Pharmacology and Pharmacometrics at the University Children's Hospital Basel (UKBB). He studied pharmaceutical sciences at ETH Zurich and received his PhD *summa cum laude* from the University of Basel in 2024. His research combines machine learning with pharmacometric modelling, in particular low-dimensional neural ordinary differential equations for automated model development, and applies model-informed dosing to improve paediatric care. He is the author of the R packages pmxNODE and optiDoseR and teaches pharmacometrics and R at FHNW and the University of Basel.
:::

## Beyond research

Scout leader since 2010, currently leading an association of more than 120 members; editor-in-chief of the ETH pharmacy student magazine *Tonikum* (2018–2020).
